description: This file defines classes for handling SIGINT signals in Node.js, including a watcher class and a fixed handler to manage duplicate signals, primarily used for graceful shutdown in the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: SigIntWatcher
classes.description: A class that watches for SIGINT signals and provides a promise that resolves when a signal is received.

classes.name: FixedNodeSIGINTHandler
classes.description: A static class managing SIGINT signal handling, including ignoring duplicate signals and installing/uninstalling handlers.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when a SIGINT signal is received.

methods.name: hadSignal
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating if a SIGINT signal has been received.

methods.name: _dispatch
methods.description: Static method that dispatches SIGINT signals to registered handlers, with logic to ignore duplicate signals.

methods.name: _install
methods.description: Installs the SIGINT handler if not already installed.

methods.name: _uninstall
methods.description: Removes the SIGINT handler if installed.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers a handler to be called on SIGINT.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Unregisters a handler from SIGINT events.
